pages.text: These commands require operator permission level 4. Run /qcraft by itself for mod information.
pages.title: Permissions

pages.text: /qcraft kit <player> gives four preconfigured Observer-Dependent pylon bases, one of each compass orientation. You still need computers, matching station layouts, and coolant.
pages.title: Give a Pylon Kit

pages.text: /qcraft clear frequencies unlinks qBlocks while keeping their locations. /qcraft clear locations removes their locations and frequency records. Both apply to the current dimension.
pages.title: Clear qBlock Records

pages.text: Use /qcraft clear all or /qcraft clear to erase both sets of qBlock records in the current dimension. Back up the world first. Quantum Computer links are stored separately.
pages.title: Before You Clear
